about_the_game:
Build

  • Grid-based furniture placement system

  • Fully customize your treetop hotel however you want

  • Upgrade your utility items and tree structure

  • Unlock better furniture and equipment with special perks

Plan

  • 4 seasons, each with their own bird species requirements

  • Have the right equipment, habitats, and furniture for your expected bird family guests

  • Manage a fleet of bird employees to handle tasks

  • Earn bird currency from satisfied guests to spend in the Build Phase

  • Prepare for random events that may positively or negatively effect your hotel

Host

  • Keep your guests happy by providing them their room service requests

  • Fix guests' broken furniture items

  • Clean guests' rooms after they check out

  • Control the location of guests in your hotel with a complex check-in computer system

  • Don't let guests leave angry, or your hotel will be forced to close!

short_description: A 3D cute management sim where you're a duck building and operating a treetop hotel for 50+ bird species. Strategically expand your tree, cater to each species’ unique needs, and keep your feathery guests happy through all four seasons. Just don’t ruffle any feathers, or it’s game over!
